sections.text_helper: Section 6.10.16 "FLASH unique boot entry address (FLASH_BOOTR_PRG)" in chapter 6 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 190.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x084
Reset value: 0xXXXX XXXX
This register can be protected against unprivileged access when PRIV = 1
inFLASH_PRIVCFGR.
This register is used to program values in corresponding option bits.
(Register bits 0 to 31 are loaded with values from the flash memory at OBL)
Bits 31:8 BOOTADD[23:0]: Unique boot entry address
These bits reflect the user memory boot address.
Bits 7:0 BOOT_LOCK[7:0]: BOOT0, BOOT_SEL, SWAP_BANK, and BOOTADD option settings lock
0xC3: BOOT0, BOOT_SEL, SWAP_BANK, and BOOTADD can still be modified following
their individual rules.
0xB4: BOOT0, BOOT_SEL, SWAP_BANK, and BOOTADD are frozen.
